dataList.name: Focused Attack - Meursault
dataList.desc:
<Pertempuran Terfokus Only>
Unit that inflicted this Focused Attack peroleh efek berikut berdasarkan target Slot's Focused Attack Stack.
  · 1x Stack: Peroleh Clash Power +1
  · 2x Stack: Peroleh Base Power +1
  · 3x Stack: Peroleh Base Power +1 dan Coin Power +1
- Kadaluarsa jika, for a giliran, unit that inflicted it fails to hit the Slot inflicted with their Focused Attack.
